messages:
Eun - Partnerships: Partner SI ran our demo on their A100 farm and saw intermittent hangs when using driver 541 + CUDA 12.2. They want a clear recommendation before onboarding.
Marco - Eng Infra: Can you get their small repro? If it's reproducible I'll run our canary. If not, ask for exact docker image and command line.
Eun - Partnerships: Sent repro bundle (logs + commands). Link in partner ticket: https://redwood-internal/partners/SI-456.
Tess - Runtime: Quick findings: hangs correlate with persistent collective ops under long sequences. On our perf harness 541 sometimes drops GPU in MIG mode. 538 was stable.
Yuri - Marketplace: We were about to flip marketplace/stable to 541 for perf gains. Given this, suggest holding flip and creating a "stable-538" channel for SI onboarding.
PartnerCI Bot: canary-job created: SI-456 / a100-mig / started. https://ci.redwood/test/SI-456
Marco - Eng Infra: Running canary now across 538/541. If can reproduce, I'll escalate to vendor and attach dmesg and nv-reports.
Tess - Runtime: Runtime action: add a short stress test to nightly that uses MIG + NCCL allreduce for 4+ hours. Also adding a quick driver-detect hook to warn users in onboarding.
Eun - Partnerships: For messaging, propose: "We are pausing the 541 driver rotation for broad rollout; SI customers will use our stable 538 images while we validate vendor fixes." I'll draft and share.
Yuri - Marketplace: Done. Holding the marketplace flip. Adding opt-in beta image with a big warning for experimental use.
PartnerCI Bot: SI-456 finished: 541 = FAIL (hang), 538 = PASS. Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/test/SI-456/logs
Marco - Eng Infra: Confirmed. Opening vendor ticket BR-820 with artifacts. Contacting vendor engineering now.
Eun - Partnerships: Thanks. I'll inform the SI PMs and pause public announcement until infra gives green.
Yuri - Marketplace: Once vendor patch validated + infra sign-off, we'll promote 541 to beta then stable. Keeping stable pinned to 538. :lock:
